label: extension

args.body:
Hello,

I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to enquire about availability for a group of 10 people during June 2024.

Could you please let me know:
1. Whether you have availability for 10 guests in June 2024, and which dates would work best;
2. What room types or configurations you can offer for a group of this size;
3. Your group booking rates and any special offers for group stays;
4. Any deposit or payment requirements for group reservations.

We are somewhat flexible on exact dates within June, so please share the options you have available.

Thank you very much for your time, and I look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
